help.title: Chat – Help
help.intro: In the chat you write directly (1:1) or in group rooms with several people and share files, photos, locations and surveys.

mention.desc: In group chats, the list of room members opens as you type. ↑↓ select an entry, Enter or Tab insert it, Escape closes the list again without changing the text you entered. In direct chats @ remains plain text.

mentionRoom.desc: Notifies all members of the room. The entry appears directly after the @ and again as soon as you have typed three characters – the short forms @team, @all and @alle find the same entry and also insert @room.

mentionMe.desc: Inserts your own name as text without notifying yourself. The entry only appears with the exact input @me – @m or @mei do not show it.

date.desc: Opens the date picker and inserts the chosen date.

location.desc: Opens the location picker and shares the chosen place.

send.desc: Sends the message. If the @ list is still open, Enter selects the highlighted entry instead.

newline.desc: Inserts a new line without sending the message.

chats.title: Direct vs. group chats
chats.direct: A direct chat is a private conversation between you and one other person.
chats.group: A group chat has several members as well as a room name and a topic.
